jobs.prompt: A Japanese mother in her early 30s sitting at a dining table in a bright modern Japanese apartment, looking down at a small ceramic baby bowl of half-eaten baby food with a slightly troubled, worried expression, one hand resting near her cheek. Natural soft daylight from a window, light wood table, clean minimal interior, warm neutral colours. She is positioned on the RIGHT side of the frame. Leave the LEFT half of the frame relatively clean and uncluttered so that text can be placed there later. Photorealistic, shot on a 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, high key Japanese advertising photography style, natural skin tones, realistic hands. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks anywhere in the image.
